description: Several piles of playing cards are spread across a wooden table, with a face-down deck near the center and a messy fan of cards toward the back. The right hand reaches to the right-side pile, pinches a card, and lifts it toward the center while the left hand hovers near and then rests on the top of the central deck; the right hand places/releases the card onto the stack and then withdraws slightly as both hands pause above the table.
